capture_dynamics: deterministic multilevel mean force; 24 indexed states (the 23-state cooling specification plus repumper-required F'=0); recoil diffusion disabled
common_random_geometry_note: the same seeded 10 directions and 25 points per direction are reused across plot points for paired curve comparisons; this correlates neighboring plotted estimates but does not carry simulation state
parameter_grid_definition: 25 evenly spaced diameters; d[7] = 12.7 mm, d[24] = 30 mm; step = 1.017647058823529 mm; start = 5.576470588235294 mm
plot_point_estimator: loading rate from all 250 capture thresholds; equivalently the mean of 10 disc-level rates, each estimated from 25 impact points
scientific_limitations: The study is aperture-limited by the fixed 12 mm-radius sampling disc, which caps the reported capture cross section at pi*(12 mm)^2. Because the random design inserts no exact boundary point, any high-diameter aperture limitation must be assessed from the saved near-rim samples.
scientific_status: requires timestep/timeout convergence and comparison with short event-driven trajectories before trusted absolute loading claims; n up to 35 also probes the high-saturation edge of the rate-equation approximation

beam_size_fixed_components: repump beam diameter at default baseline
repump power per beam at default baseline
signature_payload.beam_size_repump_rule: repump power and diameter remain at independent default baseline values
signature_payload.capture_dynamics: deterministic multilevel mean force; 24 indexed states (the 23-state cooling specification plus repumper-required F'=0); recoil diffusion disabled
signature_payload.capture_endpoint_policy: trapped lower endpoint requires either 5 ms continuous residence in the 2 mm core or two core entries with an intervening exit; escaped or configured-timeout upper endpoint; non_finite and all other termination reasons are fatal
signature_payload.geometry_sampler: 10 directions uniform in solid angle in one symmetry octant; per direction, 25 independent uniform-area disc points with independent uniform azimuth; no forced center or boundary points; all launch velocities on a disc are parallel to its inward normal
signature_payload.plot_uncertainty: direction-clustered sample standard error across 10 disc-level loading rates (25 points per disc); nominal Student-t 95 percent half-width with 9 degrees of freedom also saved
signature_payload.plot_value_estimator: loading rate from all 250 capture thresholds, algebraically equal to the arithmetic mean of the 10 disc-level loading rates
signature_payload.replicate_definition: one independently sampled incident direction and its 25 independent uniform-area impact-point capture-threshold realizations

simulation_definition: one deterministic capture-threshold search for one random impact point; 250 searches are arranged as 10 random-direction discs x 25 points
simulation_independence: each capture trajectory has independent external state; workers rebuild multilevel, apparatus, beam, and field inputs from defaults, and no dynamical or optical state carries between trajectories
